steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: Left!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Ugh!

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: Oi, Phidia—

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Me and the Raging Ironhide ARE on your left!

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: I meant, fortcrackers dropping on your left—

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: You're in my artillery's way.

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: Phidia, you still alive?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: ...*cough* *cough*...

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Seriously, I've never had a fight this difficult before.

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: You're a real sturdy rotter, aren't you? Yeah, okay, I think it's the explosion just touched you. Not much real damages I can tell.

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: Maybe I should up my fortcracker charges, 20%-some?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Then I'm never going on a mission with you again.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Hmm... joint #3's hydraulic systems aren't stable anymore. You're paying for maintenance.

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: You can't blame me—your mech's horrible for visibility. Honestly, it's only fair I let the siege-ballista do it in one of these days.

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: Should try if we get the chance, really. Ought to blast straight through, I think?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: On my pride as a Tiacauh, next intra-department meeting, I'm voting down your budget.

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: Well, that's a bloody joke! Do you understand the importance of siege weapons?!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: My master says Rhodes Island isn't installing siege weapons of any kind. It's not in accordance with our founding principles.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: But honestly? This giant bow of yours doesn't even count as siege weaponry.

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: Wha...?! A man-portable siege ballista's still a siege ballista!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: It's a bow that doesn't even have an engine.

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: Bows never HAD engines! And it's a BALLISTA!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Sorry, my tribe's bows had engines.

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: You want to go, Phidia?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: My name's Zumama.

steps.name: Agama Gang
steps.text: Hey, we're right here, you know?!

steps.name: Toddifons & Eunectes
steps.text: Shut up!

steps.name: Agama Gang
steps.text: Aaargh!

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: Then let's see if your heaping pile of scrap can take a fortcracker shot for real!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Bring it on!

steps.name: Wastelander
steps.text: Um... excuse me?

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: Are you soft? We're busy here.

steps.name: Wastelander
steps.text: You two are Rhodes Islanders?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: And you are...?

steps.name: Wastelander
steps.text: Ah, just to warn you by the way, I think that ballista had its right-side torsion hookup worn out in combat just now. Your accuracy's going to suffer if you keep making it work.

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: Tch!

steps.name: Wastelander
steps.text: The... um... yellow tractor there?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: You can call her the Raging Ironhide.

steps.name: Wastelander
steps.text: You'd better take a look at the state of her cooling systems. Put that off any longer, and you'll get funny sounds from the engine.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: You're right! Thanks, uh...

steps.name: Wastelander
steps.text: Call me Rickety Joe. Nice to meet you, Rhodes Islanders.

steps.name: Rickety Joe
steps.text: I commissioned this here mission.

steps.name: Rickety Joe
steps.text: Is your op unit... just the two of you?

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: Don't trust our professional ability?

steps.name: Rickety Joe
steps.text: Of course I do. Sesa recommended you, after all. Rhodes Island's name... is plenty well-known among wastelanders.

steps.name: Rickety Joe
steps.text: But, uh, I have to say, you two are...

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Haha... There's definitely been some mishaps...

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: Keep traveling for about an hour, and you'll be at the point where intel says the abandoned plate is.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Toddifons, Eunectes, how's your equipment checks?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Phew. Just finished loading everything into the truck.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: The Raging Ironhide's in fine condition. I gave her a total upgrade with my master earlier, and the driver's seat is a lot more comfortable now.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Oh, yeah, I haven't seen that weird little Liberi around for this mission...

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: The High Priest said I can't always count on him to drive. It's my mech, after all.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Well, no complaints here, I'll take you driving any day... Everything okay with the siege ballista, Toddifons?

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: Ugh, classic. The Doctor said there was an abandoned plate I could go hit, so I rock up.

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: And this turns out to be a rescue mission?!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: You only just now realized?

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: Hah—I spent three nights in a row up for this mission, rushing a batch of superheavy-duty fortcracker arrows! And you're telling me I'm rescuing the barreners on that stupid plate?!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Toddifons... next time, make sure to read the mission brief beforehand?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: There's a chance hostiles encamped the plate, in which case they've got defenses to counter with. You're good for assaulting fortified positions. That's why I asked the Doc to send you, just in case.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Even if we're taking on an abandoned plate, it still used to be a part of a nomadic city. It's always good to bring heavy arms.

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: *sigh* Would've gone out to town if I knew. Bloody end me—

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Apparently these wastelanders have been moving with the nomadic city for a long while, just gritting their teeth waiting for a plate to get scrapped. They were hoping they could breathe easy for a few days with it, and find some supplies in there.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Turned out 'Mama John's' and the local pasha had a reclamation contract signed already.

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: Heh. They like to do their business direct. Nothing's changed.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: We'll rendezvous at the Canning intersection. We're coming from southwest...

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: 'Scuse me, Blaze. Doesn't visibility seem a little low to you?

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: Wind's funny...

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: Abnormal weather up ahead!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: We see the sandstorm from our vehicle too!

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: Tha... That's gathering fast! Get in the truck!

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: Message from the landship, desert thunderstorm forming rapidly ahead! They'll navigate for us!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Move move move! We're distancing! Toddifons, Eunectes, find us, stat!

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: Pedal's to the metal already!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Dammit, you're still not gonna make it! Dump your equipment!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: There's no time! Dump it!

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: I'll be real here, I've got no faith in prying a second siege ballista out of Closure's pockets.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: We tuned the Raging Ironhide just last week.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Can... *zzzt* respond... *zzzt* ...ditch... landship *zzzt*...

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: Adjusting the guidance system was a pain in the neck.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Engineering's operators put so much blood and sweat into this model revision.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: ...ship...

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: Tch. The line cut out.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: There's a cave in the mountains ahead to the left!

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: Want to gamble, Phidia?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Will it work?

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: Gauging how wide the truck is? Should be fine.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: What about everything else?

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: That's what makes it a gamble—

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: Hold on tight!

steps.name: Rickety Joe
steps.text: So that's what you guys call lucky?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: We're luckier the storm was small.

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: We came back out, we bumped into whoever they were—the Agama Gang. Didn't like the process of beating 'em up, if I'm honest. Might've gone smoother if it was just me, actually.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Hey! It was your fault for shooting your arrows everywhere!

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: I did point out where they were landing. Your fault for dodging too slow.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Why you...

steps.name: Rickety Joe
steps.text: We're here.

steps.name: Rickety Joe
steps.text: Could've been a moment sooner.

steps.name: Agama Gang Leader
steps.text: Listen up! You're illegally squatting on the property of Resource Reclamation Co., subsidiary of Mama John's. Per Mama John's consumer provisions, we have the right to forcibly evict and counterattack you to a reasonable extent.

steps.name: Wastelander A
steps.text: Sir, we've never done a thing to offend anyone! Eaargh!

steps.name: Wastelander B
steps.text: M... Mercy! My kids are still here!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Those bastards...!

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: I see Originium crystals on their skin. All Infected, basically. Careful, enemy's got artillery-type arms too.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: There's fewer wastelanders on the left. I'll penetrate with the Raging Ironhide from that side. That's less accidental casualties.

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: Alright. Siege ballista erected, preparing to test-fire—

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: Round 1 failed. Adjusting position, elevating 3.2 degrees based on point of impact. Using demolishers for Round 2!

steps.name: Agama Gang Leader
steps.text: It's the tough guys HQ told us about! Return fire, return fire, don't let that tractor close in!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: I repeat! She's called the Raging Ironhide—

steps.name: Agama Gang Leader
steps.text: Don't be stingy with ammo! Fire every last shell on you!

steps.name: Rickety Joe
steps.text: Hey, Miss! Careful!

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: Zumama, brake!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Is that all the firepower you've got? Don't underestimate the Engineering Department Mech Group! This is the fruits of our—

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Uh.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Why did she stop?

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: Zumama, back up! I'll cover fire!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: I'm restarting the engine!

steps.name: Rickety Joe
steps.text: Miss, your engine's third intake burned out! I've got spare parts! Cover me!

steps.name: Agama Gang Leader
steps.text: Final warning! You are impeding execution of a Mama John's contract!

steps.name: Agama Gang Member
steps.text: Shit. Boss, our cannons are out! That redhead girl shoots like every shot's a miracle!

steps.name: Agama Gang Leader
steps.text: Zip it, I'll mess that cannoneer up myself. You go take down the snakelet.

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: Ready to fire demolisher #4!

steps.name: Agama Gang Leader
steps.text: Not on my watch!

steps.name: Agama Gang Leader
steps.text: Hah! I'm taking over here, redhead, your supersize bow's a risk to us all! Stand right there and don't move a muscle!

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: Well... this gets on my bloody nerves...

steps.name: Agama Gang Leader
steps.text: Listen, you hear me? I don't care who you are, or how those wasteland sons of bitches got in contact with you. We're cleaning out the trash here as is lawful and mandated!

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: Can you show me your contract a tic?

steps.name: Agama Gang Leader
steps.text: Hey, look, we ain't no wild brutes, we're resource reclamation practitioners. Resources mean value, means they deserve to be made use of, e.g. the parts and scrap metal here.

steps.name: Agama Gang Leader
steps.text: As for those resources that cannot be reclaimed, we're very sorry, but we will carry out appropriate procedure. I have no personal standing on these wasteland sons of bitches, but the rules are the rules.

steps.name: Agama Gang Leader
steps.text: 'Reclaim and exploit: it's the nature of civilization.' That's our company motto, plastered on the wall back at the office.

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: If you'd just been honest and told me you're about survival of the fittest, I could've—maybe—given you some respect.

steps.name: Agama Gang Leader
steps.text: Nobody asked you! Time I taught you a lesson!

steps.name: Agama Gang Leader
steps.text: Gah!

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: Now you listen to me. You go massacring and call that 'civilization?' You go slitting throats and call that 'reclamation?'

steps.name: Agama Gang Leader
steps.text: You little bitch! I thought you were artillery, what the hell—gaaah!

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: That man runs for his life with his bindle and you hound him for fun. That woman tries to save her child and you drag her off by the hair.

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: You're just a bunch of gutless nobodies who happened to find yourself some weapons, looking for anyone who's old or weak or ill or bloody impaired enough to have your fun with.

steps.name: Agama Gang Leader
steps.text: Don't you look down on me—

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: Alright, there's a little spine in you. Survival of the fittest then, fist-to-fist, let's go?

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: Telling you now, the winner here ain't you.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: You okay, Toddifons?! I'm coming to help!

steps.name: Rickety Joe
steps.text: Watch how you ride! I got your hunk of junk moving again, that's it! It's not gonna last!

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: That's your lot? Just small-fry? Tch. I was narked, but I think I've shaken it off now!

steps.name: Agama Gang Leader
steps.text: Shit, we're in too deep! Pull out, pull out!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Wow, I bust my ass getting here and it's just over? C'mon, play with me a little.

steps.name: Agama Gang Leader
steps.text: Eek—get outta here, run!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Is that a wrap?

steps.name: Rickety Joe
steps.text: Yeah, they partly scrammed. But they mentioned an agreement between Mama John's and the pasha...?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Mama John's won't acknowledge it. Still, we've gotta move these wastelanders ASAP. A couple of Infected are in pretty bad condition.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: That was pretty risky just now, Toddifons. It's lucky you...

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: What are you doing?!

steps.name: Rickety Joe
steps.text: Oh, this ballista got its string tension stabilizer sliced off. My guess is it happened when the tractor came in.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: ...Huh?

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: Alright, I'm going to hit you this once and you're going to take it!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: You busted my hydraulic system earlier!

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: Eye for an eye!

steps.name: Rickety Joe
steps.text: Aren't you gonna do something?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: ...*sigh*.

steps.name: Rickety Joe
steps.text: Er... that's the most repair work I can do you with what I've got, Miss Toddifons. You're probably gonna want to calibrate yourself.

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: This works.

steps.name: Rickety Joe
steps.text: Miss Eunectes, is your engine good?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Thanks for your spares. I think repairs are just about done.

steps.name: Rickety Joe
steps.text: Miss Blaze still has some tail-end work to finish. She says she'll meet up with you aboard the landship.

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: Fair.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Rickety Joe
steps.text: Atmosphere's got me, uh, feeling real awkward right now.

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: Seriously, why won't your barrener lot head to the Rhodes medical post nearby? They've got people sick to death.

steps.name: Rickety Joe
steps.text: That's the way we live. Ashes to ashes, dust to dust. We came to the wild, so we're bound to return to the wild.

steps.name: Rickety Joe
steps.text: Dying to Oripathy's isn't any different from dying to bandits.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: So you've never longed after... the civilization up on nomadic cities?

steps.name: Rickety Joe
steps.text: Hah... civilization.

steps.name: Rickety Joe
steps.text: We wastelanders are the ones it rejected. We can't go back.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: But your mechanical handiwork. How did you...?

steps.name: Rickety Joe
steps.text: Don't ask. Never pry into a wastelander's past life.

steps.name: Rickety Joe
steps.text: This settlement did me a favor once, and I returned it as I should. Simple as that.

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: We cross two more dunes ahead and we'll reach the landship.

steps.name: Rickety Joe
steps.text: About time I parted ways. Thanks for giving me a ride.

steps.name: Rickety Joe
steps.text: Hey, redhead.

steps.name: Rickety Joe
steps.text: You've got talent.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: We're back.

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: Yep... we're back.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: You don't sense it when you're aboard, but seeing it from this angle...

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: ...It really is such a wonder.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: I grew up in the rainforests of Sargon, never coming into contact with any sort of machinery. Everyone lives perfectly fine on their fists alone. One day, I happened to see a nomadic city pass by.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: I'll never forget the hazy, dusky shadow, the faraway rumble that morning. That was the sound of civilization and progress.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: And we're living aboard one of those right now!

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: Rhodes Island isn't a nomadic city.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: There's no talking machines in nomadic cities either!

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: Hey, Zumama.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: What do you reckon? If I fired off from this distance, would a heavy-duty fortcracker shot make it through Rhodes Island's outer armor?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Toddifons, if you ever want funds from my master again, I suggest you don't try.

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: Someone's no fun.

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: I was born in Victoria. Family of Vouivre, all immigrated from Sargon. Suppose we're from the same place, come to think. Sometimes my mam would even make Sargon stuff for dinner—supposedly, anyway.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Roast finmeat with plantains?

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: Barely as authentic. Just some red pepper tea and what have you...

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: They don't have it easy, Vouivre, finding footing in Victoria. They join the army, or they try blending in with the locals however. My family started running a factory, making... pulleys and stuff.

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: Not much amazing goes into that. Tear up some scrap, melt down to recast, keep the temperature steady, then pour it into circle molds. Anyone could do that.

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: It was like that until my granddad bought this lathe. Naff old second-hand model he got from who knows where, massive, heavy as all, used it for how many years.

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: Can you imagine, the first time it started up? It was horrible, obviously, but that massive din and the shaking, all those old parts coming to life... Couldn't even hear my own heartbeat.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: More comforting than fighting ever was, right?

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: Bloody right.

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: You said civilization and progress... We've never pointed to a lathe and said 'civilization.'

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: It just makes our lives that titchy bit better to live, that's all.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: So, that was your field mission, huh?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: That's not bad! Sounded pretty exciting to me! That red-haired Vouivre, what was she, Toddifons? She sounds like a real rock-hard fist kinda girl!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: I think you made a new friend!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Gah, who the hell?!

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: Zumama, I got the MK30 of my siege ballista all hammered out! Come to the training ground!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: You must be Toddifons!

steps.name: Toddifons
steps.text: Oh, Gavial. I'm here for a go with Eunectes.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: She was just telling me she upgraded the Raging Ironhide into the Manic Ironhide! C'mon c'mon c'mon, I'm on break today! You guys fight your hearts out, I'll be there on call, so beat the hell out of each other!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: ...*sigh*.
